scope_searched: C7 confirmatory partial corpus (279 episodes at audit time)
live_policy_positive_control.verdict: No live policy episode under object_pair produced grasp_eligible or trigger_eligible true with the runtime NaturalGraspDetector thresholds.

checks.stable_carry_triggers_after_registered_d: synthetic kinematic_state with lift_m=0.05 for 4 ticks at dt=1/15

synthetic_positive_control.verdict: G5 validates NaturalGraspDetector logic on synthetic ObjectKinematicState, not in live Isaac sim with the policy gripper.

g3_scripted_basis.verdict: G3 scripted feasibility uses a separate privileged grasp/transport controller and stage predicates (grasped, min_grasp_lift_m). It is not a live positive control for NaturalGraspDetector at policy runtime.

direct_command_gate.verdict: No object_pair V4 direct-command gate receipt producing grasp_eligible true under NaturalGraspDetector was found in-repo.

paper_distinction: Zero trigger_eligible across C7 pilots and confirmatory episodes reflects policy/sim behavior under NaturalGraspDetector, but the detector itself is validated only by G5 synthetic kinematic checks—not by a live sim positive control at the same thresholds. A detector that never fires in live episodes is materially different from a policy that never grasps; both should be reported.
